::: {#rem-variational-inference-source}
#### Variational inference maximizes the ELBO

The log evidence $\log p(x)$ does not depend on $q$.
By @thm-evidence-lower-bound-decomposition, choosing $q$ to maximize the [ELBO](#def-evidence-lower-bound)
is therefore the same as choosing $q$ to minimize its [Kullback--Leibler divergence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-kl-divergence) from the [posterior](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/bayesian-inference.html#def-posterior),
and the ELBO never exceeds the log evidence.
Variational inference searches a restricted family of choices for $q$ this way [@blei2017variational].

:::
